shared.title: The shared cells
shared.summary: The cells both quickstarts are built with: connection, a loader for each source, and a role review that profiles and approves the selected table. Open your persona's quickstart instead.

notebooks.title: Quickstart
notebooks.summary: Opens connected. Load a sample, your own CSV, Parquet or JSON file, or a connected source; review the proposed column roles and approve them before the first query. Ends by opening 01_explore.
notebooks.needs: Nothing beyond the notebook add-on: the sample-dataset cell loads Pharma (or Banking) the first time.

notebooks.title: Explore a dataset
notebooks.summary: The domain's landscape question with the SQL visible, a small scikit-learn model on this computer, and a text step with your own model traced to your Langfuse. Another dataset or your own file is one assignment away. Ends by writing the handoff the ML Engineer's 01_train starts from.
notebooks.needs: A loaded dataset (pharma_trials as it ships, banking_complaints, or your own file with its roles beside it). Optional: EXAKIT_NB_MODEL with OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY for the text step; LANGFUSE_* for tracing.

notebooks.title: Ask your data
notebooks.summary: Draft SQL from an approved descriptor, inspect and edit it, then explicitly approve the exact query before it runs with the read-only database identity.
notebooks.needs: An approved descriptor. Optional: EXAKIT_NB_MODEL and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for SQL drafting. No model is needed for the starter question.

notebooks.title: Share a checked result
notebooks.summary: Prepare a Dash Server dashboard from approved roles and visible SQL, inspect its preview, and promote only after checking the figures.
notebooks.needs: An approved descriptor and the dash-server add-on with its registered MCP tools and read-only Exasol profile.

notebooks.title: Quickstart
notebooks.summary: Opens connected. Checks the container, MLflow server and bucket directory; loads data, then lets you review and approve proposed column roles. Ends by opening 01_train.
notebooks.needs: The udf-devkit add-on with a Python container (exakit udf-setup). Optional: MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI, else a local store in mlflow/ beside the notebook.

notebooks.title: Train inside the database
notebooks.summary: Checks the Data Scientist's handoff, builds its SQL feature view, trains a logistic regression inside a Python UDF, and logs metrics, baseline, model and coefficients to MLflow.
notebooks.needs: An approved descriptor, a fresh handoff from 01_explore, a Python container (exakit udf-setup), and the kit's MLflow server (exakit mlflow start) or a local store.

notebooks.title: Score with Rust
notebooks.summary: Build a Rust UDF from 01_train's coefficients and compare its predictions with Python on the same test rows.
notebooks.needs: A fresh approved handoff, a finished 01_train MLflow run, the Rust UDF container and Docker or Podman on macOS and Windows.

notebooks.title: Score a model trained elsewhere
notebooks.summary: Brings a model trained anywhere into the bucket directory with exakit model put, creates the scoring UDF from the template, scores a table and compares with the prediction on this computer.
notebooks.needs: The ML Python container (exakit marketplace udf-devkit; older installs: exakit udf-use default) and a model file (01_train's, or your own scikit-learn pickle or ONNX file).

notebooks.title: SQL results as pandas DataFrames
notebooks.summary: Learn the SQL-to-DataFrame pattern and validate totals on the bundled reference data.
notebooks.needs: An approved reference dataset; notebook add-on.

notebooks.title: Build a decision-tree baseline
notebooks.summary: Fit and evaluate a reproducible local classifier using approved category and label roles.
notebooks.needs: An approved dataset with category and binary label roles; notebook add-on.

notebooks.title: Check the packages inside a Python UDF
notebooks.summary: Import scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, SciPy and joblib inside Exasol and report their versions.
notebooks.needs: The udf-devkit ML runtime; an approved reference dataset.

notebooks.title: Train a decision tree inside Exasol
notebooks.summary: Reuse the handoff feature view and held-out split to evaluate an alternative model inside a SET UDF.
notebooks.needs: A fresh approved handoff and the udf-devkit ML runtime.
